infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Cape Town Concierge needs access to your photos so you can upload vehicle images to the fleet.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Cape Town Concierge needs camera access if you want to take a new photo of a vehicle.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Cape Town Concierge uses your microphone to let you speak to the voice assistant.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Cape Town Concierge converts your speech to text on-device so the voice assistant can answer your questions.
